# AgentHive Inc

> AgentHive Inc (AGENTHIVEINCCOM LLC, Palm Coast, Florida) is AI ops for CTOs and COOs at funded teams of 30 to 200. We cut AI agent spend and stop loops, drift and redundant runs. Offers: a free 30-minute Architecture & Spend Triage (https://agenthiveinc.com/triage), the $2,500 fixed-price Agent Audit & Stabilization Sprint delivered in 5 business days (https://agenthiveinc.com/consult), and the $3,500/mo Fractional AI Ops Retainer with active monitoring of agent spend and failures, a 1-business-day response time, a monthly report and async help (https://agenthiveinc.com/concierge). Proof: 70+ live AI apps in production. Call +1 320-335-6186.

Built and run by Daniel Graham, a U.S. Army veteran with 10+ years in operations. Public site: https://agenthiveinc.com. AgentHive Inc · Palm Coast, FL · firstdeploy.ai.
